title: Young Woman Goes Completely Nuts During Arrest
description:
She ran away from the hospital during her ongoing treatment. The woman’s agitated behavior was only causing her more harm. Much of what the woman was saying seemed fabricated. She wasn’t going to stop her abusive behavior anytime soon. The woman was charged with Battery upon a peace officer, Resisting Arrest with Violence.
